gaps.explanation: The Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (trimmed pp11-12, printed p40) records transfers gross per department: General (126,475) out and Library 350 in; Total column (126,125). The governmental funds statement (p5, printed p15) prints the net 'Transfers to other funds' (126,125) in the General Fund column (= Water Fund 82,309 + Sewer Fund 43,816 transfers in, p7). Detail out 126,475 - statement 126,125 = 350 = the intra-General Fund transfer to the Library department. Gross per department as printed; no fix.

No business-type schedule exists; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (trimmed p7, printed p17) prints enterprise columns 'Water Fund' and 'Sewer Fund'. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 203,018 + Grants proceeds 10,000 + Interest income 736. Water: Sales 132,770 + Other revenue 431 + Grants proceeds 10,000 + Interest income 736 = 143,937. Sewer: Sales 69,667 + Other revenue 150 = 69,817. 0 + 143,937 + 69,817 = 213,754 = statement total.
